params.note: quiet default; per-scene variation only where the record's own operation asks for it

scene_rhythm.note: reading pace; the spine-index mandala holds longer (14s)

presence_tints.note: presentation policy only — held-register presence tints so the three registers stay distinct within the one whole; no colour correspondence is claimed

containment_grammar.mandala: canonical concentric layout per ql-expression-grammar.md §III: centre = the 0/1 threshold (the relation, never a summary badge); four cardinal stations = the explicate four #1–#4 (N ?/!, E −/+, S X/x, W AM/IS, per the theorem §II(a) degree table); enclosing ring = the #0/#5 envelope as circumference, frame never content
containment_grammar.depth_remnant: every depth scene (root, head) keeps a small faint ring retained in the upper left — the whole as point of departure; the route back is declared in the scene text and in the binding record, never invented
containment_grammar.thresholds: −/− opens above the centre, 1/0 returns at the ring's rim — the (4+2)+2 brackets staged as positions on the envelope, not as extra interior stations

rules: notation is locked: backticked tokens appear exactly as the records write them (−/+ with U+2212, ∞/dx, Ø); no paraphrase of a locked expression
claim-status band on every scene: the record's own claim_status (Derived / Argued), stated once in the scene text
register presences are held presences — names and Vāk offices only; register records are other workers' outputs and are referenced, never restaged
quiet records stay quiet; the darkest field in the corpus carries the least ornament
geometry stages containment, never a new ontology: the layout is the ratified mandala grammar, the sequence is the record's own traversal order
